name: status
title: network.status
lead: Says where this instance is. At most one a second is sent: the first at once, then the last of those that came after.
signature: network.status(options: {open: number, status: string ?, meta: any })

usedIn.quote: if me and me.id then network.status{ open = math.max(0, me.slots - #players.list()), status = "waiting" } end
-- When the round starts: network.status{ open = 0, status = "playing" }
